title: SLASH · The boat that can't be here
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: Alsea Bay at dawn and a riverboat on it — a paddlewheel, a dining room's windows, a helm — sitting at anchor where no riverboat could have come, its name painted over. The framer on the boat launch with the number on his cuff, comparing. It matches. The page draws the impossible plainly.

panels.composition: Full page: a small paddlewheel riverboat at anchor on a gray coastal bay at dawn, its dining-room windows dark, its name on the bow painted over in a lighter rectangle, a registration number visible below the paint; a man on a boat launch in the foreground holding his cuff up to compare.
